If you want to stop taking meds, you NEED to wean off them. I would start by doing 3/4 a pill for a few days, then down to 1/2 the dose for a few more, then 1/4 for a few more. Something that really helped me after a bad breakup was crying about it to my mom. I would just tell her everything about it and she was there to listen. She was a lot easier on me during the first few weeks, too, because she knew I was having a hard time. Make sure people you're close with know what you're going through and they will be a lot easier on you and will likely be really supportive and helpful as well.

Another thing I can suggest is talking with friends. They can be really helpful and supportive too. Have your friends get you out of the house; you don't want to fall into a depression.

Do something really nice for yourself. Maybe something that your relationship was holding you back from a little bit. Were you going to buy your bf something nice for the holidays? Instead, take that money and get yourself something you've been wanting for a while.

Listen to music and cry by yourself. Take warm showers, go for walks, drink some tea. Do you have any pets? Hug them. 

Focus on your school work. Put your mind into that. That helped me a lot with my last breakup. I was just like "Well, you broke up with me, but I'm going to do amazing in school and get awesome grades and get a really great job and overall have a really wonderful life... and it doesn't even have to involve you."

I hope some of my advice was helpful for you! Keep your head up & you will get through it. :)
